title: Flexibility Style Mix Drift
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glo:class style=*
| bin _time span=1q
| stats count as classes by _time style
| chart sum(classes) over _time by style
description: Shows how your Glo class style mix shifts quarter over quarter across yoga, Pilates, and meditation.
value: Style drift reveals whether you are balancing strength and recovery or over-indexing on one modality.
implementation: Include `style` on each Glo export and review the quarterly mix during wellness check-ins.
visualization: Stacked area chart of class count by style over quarters.
grandmaExplanation: It counts whether your practice mix is changing toward more stretching, strength, or meditation.
